rows.27:14ecc:
"Well, you turned me down when I asked you to be my friend, didn't you?
And on top of that, when I asked you a favor, you even made that put-upon face."
Hosoda seemed to be enjoying this, somehow.
"Th-That's not true!"
"You see, I never forget being hurt. Not as long as I live.
I didn't expect things to turn out like this, but now maybe you'll understand the pain in my heart."
Through my back, I felt the ceiling undulate.
It twisted a little, and a split opened up like a huge mouth.
I didn't need to look to know.
That mouth was slowly opening wide.
"I understand!
I'm sorry, it was my fault.
Please forgive me!"
I was drenched in sweat from head to toe.
Hosoda smiled at me, sweating as I was.
"Not a chance."{p}
